title: Marketing specialist
description:
About Mosaic PuzzlesMosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.Check our website for more information:Position Overview
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-drivenMarketing Specialistto join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Campaign Execution
Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.Content & Brand Communication
Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.Digital Marketing & Analytics
Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.Requirements
Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
Solid understanding ofdigital marketing analytics and performance tracking.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
Knowledge of SEO is a plus.How to Apply
Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment
The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:
Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

description:

Planejar e implementar estratégias de marketing digital.
Gerenciar campanhas em diferentes canais online.
Monitorar métricas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
Analisar dados e identificar oportunidades de otimização.

title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes
You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\"We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups
If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP
Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals
Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools
We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners
This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Marketing specialist
description:
About Mosaic PuzzlesMosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.Check our website for more information:Position Overview
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-drivenMarketing Specialistto join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Campaign Execution
Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.Content & Brand Communication
Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.Digital Marketing & Analytics
Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.Requirements
Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
Solid understanding ofdigital marketing analytics and performance tracking.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
Knowledge of SEO is a plus.How to Apply
Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment
The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:
Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Devops engineer
description:
We're looking for a Dev Ops / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.
We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists
We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing Dev Ops operations and architecture support.
We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.
Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL; DR
You will help lead cloud and Dev Ops initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:
Lead cloud migrations to OCI
Design cloud architectures
Automate migrations and infrastructure
Coordinate Dev Ops engineers
Talk directly to clients
Help build repeatable Dev Ops processes
You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.
English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based Dev Ops job
If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.
This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\"We can automate 80% of this.\"
And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do
Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations
A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.
Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation
We want to automate everything that can be automated:
Automated infrastructure provisioning
Migration scripts
CI/CD pipelines
Environment replication
Monitoring setups
If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions
You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading Dev Ops Engineers
As the Dev Ops work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for
You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.
You likely:
Love automating infrastructure
Hate manual processes
Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
Are comfortable debugging production environments
Enjoy designing architectures
Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like Chat GPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations
Cloud
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
AWS
Azure
GCP
Dev Ops
Docker
Kubernetes
Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
CI/CD pipelines
Linux systems administration
Networking fundamentals
Automation
Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages
Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave
We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.
Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.
Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits
This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.
Fully remote work
Flexible hours
22 days paid time off per year
Quarterly bonus based on company performance
AI allowance for productivity tools
We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process
Application review
Technical conversation
Architecture discussion
Conversation(s) with one or more partners
This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the Dev Ops work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

Alguém que gosta de atuar em ambientes que valorizam competência, transparência e confiança.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement

Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager

title: Manager, corporate development - m&a origination & deal sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.comThe Role
The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes
Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies
At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements
Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U. S., and Portugal.
Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Mainframe storage engineer (home office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM z OS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.
Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .
All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).
We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.
Job responsibilities :
Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools. Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.
Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles. Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL . Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs. Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System . Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as: >> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM) Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems >> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,
operational considerations).
>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training). Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.
Preferred Skills and Proficiencies: Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E . Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z . Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida

Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Salário e benefícios competitivos.

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.
Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .
All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).
We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.
You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.
Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.
Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role. IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience. TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management. JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language. REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts. System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required. Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.
Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z . Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
 
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.  Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.  Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 
Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.
Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level
To Apply Submit:
Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history
If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview
Requirements Before Employment
Signed Confidentiality agreement
Signed Non-compete agreement
Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form
Company Culture
Remote
We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
Hours 8 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products. Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow. Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery. Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability. Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks. What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models… Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact. Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

title: Social seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto) Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital
Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?
Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?
Então essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Red Suit
Na Red Suit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.
Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.
O que faz um Social Seller?
O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, Linked In e outros canais).
Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.
Responsabilidades Principais
Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia O que esperamos de você Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos) Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular) O que oferecemos
Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)
Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.
Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .
All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).
We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.
You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.
Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.
Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role. IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience. TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management. JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language. REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts. System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required. Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.
Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.
What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.

﻿Responsabilidades:
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.

Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.

title: Human resources specialist
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.
Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.
Joining our team you will be focusing on
Working as an integral part of the Turn Key HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.
Required Skills
A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
Client-facing experience
Advanced level of English
Great interpersonal and influencing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Experience with HRIS
Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload
Personal competencies
Growth Mindset
Proactive and enthusiastic
Initiative and creativity
Achievement drive and optimism
Interpersonal and Communication Skills
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
Why You Should Work at Turn Key
We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
Provided laptop (Mac Books)
Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
Private health & dental insurance
Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
Fully Remote work
Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
Access to a special online shop where you can use Turn Key coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.
Key skills : Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles. Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL . Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs. Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System . Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as: >> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM) Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems >> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,
operational considerations).
>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training). Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.
